questions.cardDe: In der DDR gab es nicht nur Karl-Marx-Stadt, sondern auch Marxwalde. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Wie hieß die brandenburgische Gemeinde Neuhardenberg in der DDR zu Ehren von Karl Marx?
questions.en: What was the Brandenburg municipality of Neuhardenberg called in the GDR in honour of Karl Marx?

timeline.labelEn: Neuhardenberg in Brandenburg bears the name Marxwalde in honour of Karl Marx
timeline.labelDe: Neuhardenberg in Brandenburg trägt zu Ehren von Karl Marx den Namen Marxwalde

questions.notes: True/false reworked (the card's statement is true). de.wikipedia: renamed Marxwalde on 1 May 1949; name used 1949–1990, then Neuhardenberg again.

questions.cardDe: Welche ist keine von Robert Gernhardt mitgestaltete Satirezeitschrift: Pardon, Titanic oder Eulenspiegel?
questions.de: Welches Satiremagazin gründete Robert Gernhardt 1979 mit?
questions.en: Which satirical magazine did Robert Gernhardt co-found in 1979?

timeline.labelEn: First issue of the German satirical magazine Titanic

questions.notes: 'Which is NOT' multiple choice reworked; the card's answer is Eulenspiegel (an East German magazine). de.wikipedia: Gernhardt was an editor of Pardon and co-founder of Titanic, whose first issue appeared in November 1979 (de.wikipedia 'Titanic (Magazin)').
